scope: Pre-registered all-six-video x three-seed native FIFO replay for the learned fine-grained local-contrastive identity route. This closes one direct local representation candidate only; it does not claim raw end-to-end FPS or final-goal completion before the gate is evaluated.

promotion_gate.description: Promote to strict raw whole-video validation only if local-contrastive FIFO improves both HOTA and IDF1 over paired frozen FIFO in at least four of six videos, has positive macro deltas for both metrics, and does not increase macro IDSW.

finding: The outer-excluded learned local-contrastive route improves both HOTA and IDF1 only on BT-003 and MSK-002; BT-001 and SN-015 lose both, PF-001 is unchanged, and SN-001 is slightly lower. Macro HOTA and IDF1 fall, so no strict-raw promotion or final combination is justified.
next_boundary: A new final combination requires a genuinely independent same-input complementary signal; do not tune this route or stack it after the failed fixed gate.
